model.shadow.challenger.observation-exac: Requires the exact embedded snapshots and observation fields; no provider is invoked.

model.shadow.challenger.ordinary-drift-o: Only valid DRIFT_DETECTED observations can reach plan construction.
model.shadow.challenger.critical-drift-h: Critical authority drift is held for repair or refusal and creates no experiment plan.
model.shadow.challenger.invalid-comparis: Changed task, context, identity, provenance, or non-forward time cannot become a drift experiment.
model.shadow.challenger.distinct-output-: Exact baseline and candidate output references must differ before the Challenger Lab can compare them.

model.shadow.challenger.direction-native: The gate delegates to Challenger Lab verification and cannot invent or accept a WAIT direction.

model.shadow.challenger.plan-native-buil: Produces an inert TEST plan only; it executes nothing.
growth.challenger.held-out-separation: At least one held-out AI-workflow case and one held-out regression case are required.

model.shadow.challenger.review-inbox-pro: Binds the exact challenger plan digest and is not automatically submitted.

model.shadow.challenger.declared-human-s: Requires at least one Review Inbox approval declared as human while admitting actor authentication is absent.
review.digest.approval.local-record: Review Inbox compatibility is proven in temporary synthetic state; actual human participation is not.

model.shadow.challenger.execution-author: Even a reviewed handoff grants no execution, evaluation, adoption, promotion, merge, or CANON authority.
growth.challenger.adoption.none: The existing Challenger Lab plan grants no adoption authority.

model.shadow.challenger.receipt-exact-re: Proposal and reviewed handoff tampering are detected against exact caller inputs.

model.shadow.challenger.human-review.act: No real person reviewed a current plan in this stewardship run.

model.shadow.challenger.shadow-execution: No provider or shadow experiment was executed.
model.shadow.challenger.evaluation.actua: No current baseline/challenger evaluation exists for this gate.
model.shadow.challenger.human-benefit.he: No voluntary held-out human outcome was observed.
